# Solid Hyperobjects: implementation and verification context

Last Updated: 2026-09-29

## Instructions and ownership

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [README.md](README.md) and
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before changing geometry. This repository owns
solid cartridges and their authored manifests, source, presets and provenance.
The [manifest and source layout](README.md#layout) keeps each cartridge at the
repository root; Yantra4D consumes it through one pinned `projects` submodule.
Platform services belong to [Yantra4D](https://github.com/madfam-org/yantra4d),
shared validators to [hyperobjects-spec](https://github.com/madfam-org/hyperobjects-spec),
and soft patterns to [soft-hyperobjects](https://github.com/madfam-org/soft-hyperobjects).
Preserve those boundaries and explicit package/submodule revisions.

## Current evidence and verification

The 2026-09-29 manifest census has 502 cartridges, 500 base body-count declarations,
502 manifests with constraints, 20 animated cartridges and five cartridges with
reasoned parity exemptions or widened tolerances. These are dated inventory
counts, not proof that every geometry is currently valid. Read current CI for
its checked revision, render scope, failures, notes and skips.

[CI](.github/workflows/ci.yml) pins verifier `38df6b49424f41def96a84168d78b5ed7e868e87` at this checkpoint;
read `SPEC_PIN` there before installing. Its per-PR lane renders changed
cartridges; its nightly lane checks the whole commons and validates completeness.
The [contributor verification command](CONTRIBUTING.md) supplies both `libs` and
the repository root as OpenSCAD search paths. Preserve the shell's checker exit
status through `tee`; a successful pipeline consumer is not the checker verdict.

Validate B-Rep geometry before exporting, then require watertight meshes,
positive volume, declared body counts and applicable cross-kernel parity.
A local macOS pass cannot replace Linux CI. A schema pass, import success or
skipped kernel check cannot establish modeling correctness. Never widen a
tolerance, alter the declared body count, or add an exemption to conceal a defect.

[Keytag](keytag/docs/README.md) records a concrete text failure: implicit Arial
fallback changes by environment, while selecting the installed Liberation Sans
family makes the shipped cases reproducible. The [manifest](keytag/project.json)
defines the tested modes/presets and [source](keytag/main.py) defines geometry.
Arbitrary text and every parameter combination still need their own acceptance.

## Publication and boundaries

One cartridge per geometry PR; sign commits with DCO. Require full exact-head CI
before merging. A source merge does not update production: the platform must
advance its commons pin, regenerate derived catalogs, pass its own checks,
publish applicable signed images and verify the running release.

[NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) owns license carve-outs. Follow
[the public/private boundary](docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md): do not commit
credentials, private customer data, staff identities or raw operational logs.
Routine production operations use Enclii; approved secret material uses its
intake flow. Licensing, access and governance rulings remain with the operator.

[agent instructions](AGENTS.md), [contribution rules](CONTRIBUTING.md).
